# 2048

The test game, until FloorFifty is added: 2048 by Gabriele Cirulli, from https://github.com/gabrielecirulli/2048 at commit
478b6ec346e3787f589e4af751378d06ded4cbbc, under the MIT licence in `LICENSE.txt` beside this file.

The files are copied byte for byte. Left out: the Sass sources (`style/*.scss`), `Rakefile`, `README.md` and
`CONTRIBUTING.md`, which the game does not load.

Its fonts in `style/fonts/` are Clear Sans by Intel, which 2048's repository ships with it; Clear Sans is under the
Apache License 2.0.
